activity.notes: Umberto I succeeded Victor Emmanuel II as King of Italy on 9 January 1878 and reigned until his assassination at Monza on 29 July 1900.

sources.title: Umberto I re d'Italia — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Umberto I's accession on 9 January 1878 and assassination at Monza on 29 July 1900.

sources.title: FRUS 1878 — Accession of Umberto I
sources.citation_text: A contemporary U.S. diplomatic dispatch announces the death of Victor Emmanuel II and accession of Crown Prince Umberto as Umberto I, King of Italy, in January 1878.
